preserved_current_public_contracts: Current pangu_lifecycle_api table is queried at its exact ABI version/size; no private runtime_prepare_items or pangu_owner_enter/leave helper is imported.
Public prepare checks cover budget refusal with unchanged output/count, invalid planner views, invalid bindings/order/state, short storage and duplicate owner frames.
Startup success, -71 setup failure with prefix rollback, reentrant stop, reverse cleanup and provider retention checks run against 95 valid /145 rejected plans.
86 actual public dependency calls hold both owners during stop and release through call_finish.
All 1,414 async cases preserve seven modes, each 202: deferred success/failure, cancellation, async disposer, inline finish, protocol conflict and reentrant stop/late setup.

documented_api_adaptation.old_private_behavior: The old test entered one arbitrary owner without a service binding and released it later.
documented_api_adaptation.current_public_behavior: The public call API requires a real resolved dependency binding and retains both consumer and provider.
documented_api_adaptation.observed_difference: 86 hold scenarios had a real edge and exercised the public call ticket; 106 had no incident edge and therefore exercised ordinary stop without an artificial in-flight ticket.
documented_api_adaptation.decision: Do not re-export the removed single-owner private helper. Record the 106 cases as intentionally unsupported old-only semantics.

attempt_history: Strict compilation initially rejected an unused local and an unused ticket variable; both were removed.
A test-only owner reset initially attempted to initialize a still-LOADING frame; it now follows the established epoch/reinitialization rule.
An initial assertion incorrectly expected never-started owners to be DISPOSED; final assertions require only the actually started prefix to be disposed and leave untouched tail owners LOADING.
not_claimed: Legacy private owner-only in-flight semantics for 106 cases are not claimed as covered.
No byte-identical legacy assertion suite, independent event-by-event trace oracle, complete G04/G07, production admission, protected remote approval, or performance budget is claimed.
UBSan does not instrument assembly memory provider code.

review.decision: Accept F01/F16 current-public-ABI regression coverage with documented adaptation; preserve the 106 old-only cases as an explicit difference. Full T14 remains incomplete.
risks: 106 legacy waits were private owner-only holds without a matching public dependency edge.
The runner is an isolated candidate; external trust approval remains pending.
The test validates lifecycle contracts, not product memory safety or performance.
